title: Causes in Ecology: Formal Cause Words
goal: I can name the cause of an ecological change in formal Hungarian (*következtében*, *folytán*, *nyomán*, *eredményeként*).
I can talk about drought and the drying of land (*elsivatagosodás*, *aszálykár*, *antropogén hatás*).
I can say what caused the groundwater to fall.

sections.title: Unit 20: The Drying Alföld
body: This unit is about drought, drained land and the water of the Alföld: causes in nature, damaged landscapes, short-term profit and long-term cost, river regulation and what could have been done differently.
The unit ends with a short text about the forest engineer Kaán Károly and the afforestation of the Alföld.
